name: agents_list
description: The user's other agents you can message: id, name, what each is for (description), and whether it is your temporary helper.

name: agent_send
description: Send a message to other agents. Use it when the user asks you to hand work to another agent ("ask Boss to …"), or when an agent's purpose fits the task better. With expects_reply, each recipient works on it and its answer comes back to you; you report it in your chat. Leave out `conversation` to start one (then `subject` is required); pass it, and `in_reply_to`, to answer in one. Attachments are ticket tokens only (@plugin:scope:tkt_…).

to.description: An agent id or name (from agents_list), a list of them, or "*" for all of them.

subject.description: What it is about, at most 120 characters. Required for a new conversation.

data.description: Structured data for the recipient, at most 64 KB.

deadline.description: RFC 3339: past it an undelivered message is dropped.

name: agent_conversations
description: Your recent conversations with other agents: subject, participants, last message time, message count.

with.description: Only those with this agent id.

name: agent_read
description: The messages of one of your conversations with other agents, oldest first.

since.description: A message id or a time.

name: agent_create
description: Create an agent. temporary: false when the user asked for a new agent ("assign a new agent to …"): it is listed with the user's agents and only the user removes it. temporary: true when you decide you need a helper for a task: it is not listed, you may have one at a time, and you remove it with agent_remove when the task ends. It gets the model the user named, else yours, and at most your plugins. first_message hands it the task.

purpose.description: What it is for; shown in agents_list so later requests find it.

model.description: Only the model the user named.

plugins.description: A subset of your plugins; all of yours when left out.

name: agent_remove
description: End a temporary helper you created, when its task is done. Its chat stays readable under Past helpers.
